summary: Python 2.5 introduced the 'with' statement for context managers, enabling RAII-like behavior (acquire lock, open file, etc.) and replacing common try/finally idioms. Conditional expressions (x if c else y), the any() and all() builtins, and improved parsing were added. The logo used since 2.5 (the familiar blue-and-yellow snakes) dates from this era.
notes: Unsupported since 2011-05-26. Last micro 2.5.6. The 'with' statement became essential for resource management and inspired similar constructs in other languages.
